architecture.summary: SO-11 adds documents only: docs/implementation/tenant-fleet-runbooks.md holds the operator runbooks of the tenant fleet (a failed provision, an orphaned Render service, a paused Supabase project, the deletion of a tenant), the rotations (the three Render API keys, the gateway key pair, LOGGING_DESTINATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY, and the GitHub token of the registry credential ghcr-thermus-hosted-read), the monthly GHCR pruning, the shared Brave search limit, and the alerts (the Render failure emails of the Hobby plan and three Axiom monitors that the owner makes). The runbooks describe the merged behavior of SO-02, SO-04, and SO-06, and they mark each step that waits for SO-05, SO-09, or SO-10. No source, test, configuration, workflow, or migration changes, so no component, edge, public module, declaration, deployment, or runtime behavior changes. README, the docs index, and the plan gain links; the README pruning rule also keeps the TENANT_IMAGE digest. The registry gains one prose paragraph in the deployment view: it names the runbooks and the log path that the Axiom monitors need, because the control plane writes its system log only to standard error on main. No Mermaid block changes.
